### Added
- **klaus-gateway's traces go to the platform's OTLP gateway by default, and the gateway's egress rule to it renders** (giantswarm/klaus-gateway#263). Until now `klausGateway.observability.otlpEndpoint` was empty on every installation, so the gateway's tracer provider was a no-op, the A2A call carried no trace context and the kagent controller's `SendStreamingMessage` trace in Tempo had no parent — a Slack round trip could only be reconstructed from five logs. klaus-gateway 1.10.0 opens one span per turn (`slack.turn`, the parent of the controller's trace and of the actor's spans under it), takes a URL endpoint and an `otlpHeaders` knob; the meta chart now sets both to the target kagent's exporters use — `http://otlp-gateway.kube-system.svc:4317` with `X-Scope-OrgID: giantswarm` — under a new `klausGateway.observability.enabled: auto` that follows the resolved `global.observability.metrics.serviceMonitor.enabled` the way `kagent.otel.*.enabled` does (an explicit `true`/`false` wins; off, the release gets an empty endpoint and no headers; the knob itself never reaches the klaus-gateway chart, whose closed `observability` block takes the endpoint and headers only — `components.klaus-gateway.omitKeys`). The connectivity chart renders `-klausgateway-otlp-egress` exactly while the endpoint is set — DNS plus the endpoint's namespace on its port (the cluster entity for a host that is not an in-cluster Service), in both policy flavours — through the destination parsing and the rule the kagent controller's and the actors' OTLP egress already used, now shared as `agent-platform.otlpTarget` / `agent-platform.otlpEgressRule`. `components.klaus-gateway.versionRange` moves to `>=1.10.0 <2.0.0` (the floor: an older chart's schema refuses the headers knob) and the example BOM pins 1.10.0. `make verify-klausgateway-otlp` asserts the forwarding, the `auto` resolution and the overrides, both flavours of the policy, the guards, and that the kagent controller's rule is unchanged. **Every installation with the klaus-gateway component on rolls it once** (the new chart and the two new arguments) and starts exporting one trace per Slack turn to its Tempo tenant.
